user_problem: Measurements use mixed units and need a transparent conversion plan before any values are transformed.
unique_output: A field-by-field normalization specification with target units, supplied conversion formulas, precision, and blocked cases.
required_input: Fields, source units, desired units, approved conversion formulas, rounding rules, and ambiguous-unit examples.
critical_rule: Never supply an unstated conversion factor or guess an unlabeled unit; quarantine ambiguous values.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is dataset-field-dictionary-builder; this plans controlled value conversion rather than documenting field meaning.
acceptance_scenario: Input weights 1000 g and 2 kg, target kg, formula g÷1000, two decimals; third value 5 has no unit. Output specifies 1.00 kg and 2.00 kg, while quarantining 5.
